passive.name: A Promise
passive.text: Increases the wearer's SPD by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer's memosprite uses Memosprite Skill on one ally, gains "Blank," which increases DMG taken by all enemies by **10/12/14/16/18%**. When the wearer's memosprite uses Memosprite Skill on an enemy, gains "Verse," which increases CRIT DMG of all allies by **16/19/22/25/28%**. When the wearer's memosprite has both "Blank" and "Verse," increases the effects of both "Blank" and "Verse" by **60/65/70/75/80%**.

weapons.name: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

passive.name: Tolerant
passive.text: Increases the wearer's SPD by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, consumes all allies' HP equal to **1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2%** of their current HP, and after the next attack of the wearer's memosprite, enables it to additionally deal 1 instance of Additional DMG equal to **250/312.5/375/437.5/500%** of the total consumed HP to the attacked target, with the damage type based on the memosprite's type. Then, the total consumed HP is reset. When the wearer's memosprite uses Memosprite Skill, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%**, lasting for **2** turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Reception
passive.text: Increases the wearer's SPD by **6/7.5/9/10.5/12%**. After the wearer uses Skill, increases the DMG dealt by all allies by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **3** turn(s).

substatLine: SPD (until 180/200) > Crit Rate > Crit DMG > HP%
skillPriority: Memosprite Skill > Skill > Talent = Ultimate > Memosprite Talent > Basic ATK
tracePriority: Ripples Across Time (A4) > Causality in Trichotomy (A6) > Child of Remembrance (A2)

entries.name: Lo, Hope Takes Flight!
entries.text: Gains **1** "Recollection" point(s) and deals Ice DMG equal to **50%** of Cyrene's Max HP to one designated enemy.

entries.name: To Love and Tomorrow ♪
entries.text:
Gains **3** "Recollection" points and deals Ice DMG equal to **30%** of Cyrene's Max HP to one designated enemy. Then, deals Ice DMG equal to **30%** of Cyrene's Max HP to all enemies.
"To Love and Tomorrow ♪" cannot recover Skill Points.

entries.name: Bloom, Elysium of Beyond
entries.text: Gains **3** "Recollection" point(s) and deploys a Zone that lasts for **2** turns. The Zone's duration decreases by 1 at the start of Cyrene's every turn. While the Zone lasts, for each instance of DMG dealt by all ally targets, deals 1 additional instance of True DMG equal to **24%** of the original DMG. When Cyrene is downed, the Zone will also be dispelled.

entries.name: Verse ◦ Vow ∞
entries.text:
Summons memosprite Demiurge, causes it to immediately gain 1 extra turn, and activates all teammates' Ultimate. Then, enters the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state. Enhances Basic ATK to "To Love and Tomorrow ♪" and can only use this Basic ATK. Increases Cyrene's and Demiurge's CRIT Rate by **50%**, and deploys the Zone effect from Skill with no duration limit.
Can only be used once per battle. Demiurge's initial Max HP equals to **100%** of Cyrene's Max HP.

entries.name: Reunion at First Sight
entries.text: Enables Demiurge to immediately gain 1 extra turn.

entries.name: Hearts Gather as One
entries.text: When combat begins or after Cyrene takes action, other ally characters under any state and their memosprites gain "Future." When ally targets with "Future" take action, consumes "Future" to grant Cyrene **1** "Recollection" point(s). When Cyrene has **24** "Recollection" points, can activate Ultimate and dispel all debuffs on her. When she has **12** "Recollection" points during the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state, can activate Ultimate. After reaching the maximum, it can overflow by up to **27** points. While Cyrene is on the field, increases DMG dealt by all ally targets by **20%**.

entries.name: Peace at West Wind's End
entries.text: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for **30** second(s) around the character. Enemies within this Special Dimension enter the "This Moment, Forever" state. While in this state, enemies will cease all actions. Ally characters within this Special Dimension have **50%** increased movement speed. After entering combat within the duration, deploys the Skill's Zone. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

entries.name: Minuet of Blooms and Plumes
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to **60%** of Demiurge's Max HP.

entries.name: This Ode, to All Lives
entries.text: Applies a buff to one designated ally character. When the character is a Chrysos Heir, the target gains a special effect. When the character is not a Chrysos Heir, increases the target's DMG dealt by **40%** for **2** turns. This effect also applies on memosprites.

entries.name: Ode to Genesis
entries.text: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK by an amount equal to **16%** of Demiurge's Max HP, and increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s CRIT Rate by an amount equal to **72%** of Demiurge's CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK in this battle, Demiurge immediately gains 1 extra turn and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." If the target was defeated before this ability is used, it will be used on newly appeared enemy targets instead.

entries.name: Ode to Romance
entries.text: One-time effect. When used on Aglaea, causes Aglaea to gain "Romance" and immediately stacks Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker uses an attack, consumes "Romance" and regenerates **70** Energy. Increases DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker by **72%**, and ignores **36%** of the targets' DEF, lasting until Aglaea exits the "Supreme Stance" state.

entries.name: Ode to Passage
entries.text: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Tribbie, causes DMG dealt by Tribbie to ignore **12%** of enemies' DEF. When Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK and triggers the Additional DMG from Tribbie's Zone, it further deals **1** instance(s) of Additional DMG.

entries.name: Ode to Strife
entries.text: One-time effect. When used on Mydei, removes all Crowd Control debuffs inflicted on him. And if Mydei is in the "Vendetta" state, he automatically uses 1 instance of "Godslayer Be God" without consuming Charge. Mydei's CRIT DMG increases by **200%** during this attack. If the target gets defeated before the use, then it will target the newly arriving enemy targets instead. If Mydei is not in the "Vendetta" state, then advances Mydei's action by **100%**.

entries.name: Ode to Life and Death
entries.text: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Castorice, "Newbud" can overflow up to **200%**. When summoning Netherwing, consumes all overflowing "Newbud." For every 1% overflow amount consumed, increases the multiplier by **0.24%** for the DMG dealt when this summoned Netherwing triggers the ability effect of its Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins." If there are **2** enemy target(s) or fewer on the field when summoned, the DMG multiplier additionally increases by **0.48%**.

entries.name: Ode to Reason
entries.text: One-time effect. When used on Anaxa, recovers **1** Skill Point(s) for allies and enables Anaxa to take action immediately. Skill has **3** more instances of DMG, lasting for 1 turn. The next time Anaxa uses Basic ATK or Skill, he gains "True Knowledge": All Erudition characters have their ATK increased by **60%** and their dealt Skill DMG increased by **40%**, lasting until the start of Anaxa's next turn.

entries.name: Ode to Sky
entries.text: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, causes Hyacine to gain 2 stacks of "Ode to Sky." When used on Hyacine, regenerates **24** Energy for Hyacine. When Hyacine has "Ode to Sky" and is providing healing, additionally increases the amount to be included in the tally of Little Ica's Memosprite Skill by an amount equal to **72%** of the current healing amount. After Hyacine uses Skill/Ultimate, consumes 1 stack of "Ode to Sky."

entries.name: Ode to Trickery
entries.text: Effective for the entire battle. When used on Cipher, increases the DMG dealt by Cipher by **36%**, decreases the DEF of the "Patron" by **20%** and decreases the DEF of all other enemy targets by **12%**.

entries.name: Ode to Worldbearing
entries.text: Effective for the entire battle. After it is used on Phainon, Phainon gains **6** "Coreflame" as well as "Eternal Ignition" when Transforming. When Transforming, if "Coreflame" exceeds **12**, for each point in excess, Khaslana's CRIT DMG increases by **12%**, up to a max increase of **72%**. While "Eternal Ignition" persists, increases Khaslana's CRIT Rate by **16%**. After the extra turns are depleted, the Transformation does not end, and all of Khaslana's extra turns get refreshed and **4** "Scourge" is granted. At the start of extra turns, Khaslana consumes HP equal to **15%** of his current HP. After using an attack, deals **5** instances of Additional DMG, with each instance dealing Fire Additional DMG equal to **10%** of Khaslana's ATK to one random enemy.

entries.name: Ode to Ocean
entries.text: One-time effect. When used on Hysilens, Hysilens gains "Flowing Warmth." After Hysilens uses an attack, consumes "Flowing Warmth" and regenerates **60** Energy for this unit. In this battle, increases the DMG dealt by Hysilens by **120%**. After Hysilens uses Basic ATK/Skill to attack enemies, causes all the DoT currently applied on the attacked enemy targets to immediately produce DMG equal to **60%**/**80%** of the original DMG.

entries.name: Ode to Law
entries.text: Effective for the entire battle. After using on Cerydra, increases the CRIT DMG of the character with "Military Merit" by **30%**. After Coup de Main ends, Cerydra immediately gains **1** Charge.

entries.name: Ode to Time
entries.text: Effective for the entire battle. After it is used on Evernight, increases the DMG dealt when Evey uses the Memosprite Skill "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew" by **18%**. After Evernight uses Skill/Ultimate, additionally gains **1** "Memoria." The CRIT DMG boost effect provided by the Skill is further increased by an amount equal to **12%** of Evernight's CRIT DMG.

entries.name: Ode to Earth
entries.text: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, grants "Ode to Earth" to Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, and enables the next **3** attack(s) of "Souldragon" to deal Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type, equal to **80%** of the Bondmate's Shield Effect. When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae holds "Ode to Earth," the "Bondmate" deals **24%** increased DMG. When used on Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, advances Souldragon's action by 100%. Souldragon's next action gains the enhancement effect of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate and the Shield Effect provided by Souldragon is **150%** of its original Shield Effect. Does not consume the enhancement number of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate.

entries.name: Ode to Ego
entries.text: For every 1 different teammate (i.e., excluding Demiurge) from whom Cyrene has gained "Recollection," additionally deals 1 instance of Ice DMG equal to **60%** of Demiurge's Max HP to one random enemy when Demiurge uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." After Cyrene uses Ultimate or when Demiurge is summoned, Demiurge immediately gains 1 "Story." When "Story" reaches **3**, Demiurge consumes all "Story" points to immediately gain 1 extra turn and automatically use "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes."

entries.name: Waiting, In Every Past
entries.text: Demiurge's SPD remains at 0, and it will not appear on the Action Order. While on the field, it is considered as Out-of-Bounds. When Cyrene's HP percentage changes, Demiurge's HP percentage will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's and Demiurge's Max HP increases by **24%**. After Demiurge uses abilities, decreases the duration of all Continuous Effects on this unit by 1.

entries.name: "Hello, World ♪"
entries.text: When Demiurge is summoned, dispels Crowd Control debuffs from all allies.

entries.name: Child of Remembrance
entries.text: When a teammate's memosprite is summoned, it gains "Future." "Future" held by the memosprite won't be consumed.

entries.name: Ripples Across Time
entries.text: When there are 1/2/3 Chrysos Heir or Remembrance characters (excluding Cyrene) in the team, Cyrene gains **2**/**3**/**6** "Recollection" point(s) respectively at the start of combat.

entries.name: Causality in Trichotomy
entries.text: When Cyrene's SPD is **180** or higher, increases all allies' DMG dealt by **20%**. Then, for every 1 SPD that exceeds **180**, increases Cyrene's and Demiurge's Ice RES PEN by **2%**. Up to a maximum of **60** excess SPD can be taken into account for this effect.

entries.name: Epics, Born on a Blank Slate
entries.text: When Demiurge triggers the Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" during the use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes," gains 6 "Recollection" point(s) and increases the number of bounces for this attack by 12.

entries.name: A Tomorrow in Thirteen Shades
entries.text: When entering combat, additionally gains 12 "Recollection" point(s). For every 1 different ally character that gains the Memosprite Skill buff from Demiurge, the DMG multiplier for the True DMG dealt by ally targets via the Skill's Zone increases by 6%, up to a max increase of 24%.

entries.name: By Thy Being, As I've Written
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Please Write On, With a Smile
entries.text: After every 1 use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes" by Demiurge, the Bounce DMG multiplier for the triggered Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" increases by 6% in the current battle, stacking up to 24 times.

entries.name: Gaze, Steeped in Yesterbloom
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Remembrance, Sung in Ripples ♪
entries.text:
When Cyrene uses Ultimate for the first time, all allies advance action by 100%. Each time Demiurge triggers the Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" during the use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes," gains the following effects based on the number of times it has been triggered in the current battle:
1 time: When Demiurge is on the field, reduces all enemy targets' DEF by 20%.
2 times and more: All allies advance action by 24%.
